g.text: One paper counted once per row

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 21px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #18384b

g.text: 02 Stages × Digital Twin and enabling functions

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #546371

g.text: Twelve assessed domain / enabling studies. Functions are counted; this is not a count of twelve validated DTs.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #546371

g.text: Stage records with described functions: S1=7, S2=7, S3=2, S4=2, S5=1, X=3. Stage memberships overlap.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #546371

g.text: * Adjacent construction logistics, cost and schedule studies are not relabelled as building-stock turnover.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #546371

g.text: S3 includes retrospective event detection; S4 includes reuse information; neither label proves probabilistic flow/recovery modelling.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #546371

g.text: Zero = not positively coded, not proven absence. Sparse S4/S5 coverage is a property of this subset, not the entire literature.
